senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (भटति)
1 To hold or cherish.
2 To hire or maintain.
3 To speak.
(इ) भटि r. 10th cl. (भंटयति)
To deceive.

m. (-टः)
1 A warrior, a soldier, a combatant.
2 A barbarian, or outcast of a particular tribe.
3 A goblin.
E.
भट to maintain, aff. अच्.

m. (-ट्टः)
1 A philosopher, a learned man, especially one conversant with the philosophical systems.
2 An enemy.
3 Best, excellent.
4 Authority.

mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं)
Roasted on a spit, (meat, &c.)
E.
भट to nourish, इत्र aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Worshipful, reverend, entitled to homage or respect: see the next.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Venerable, respectable, entitled to reverence or to homage.
m. (-कः)
1 A sage, a Muni or saint.
2 A deity.
3 (In theatrical language) A king.
4 The sun.
5 A term especially applied to a Bauddha teacher.
E.
भट to nourish, aff. क्विप्, तृ to pass, aff. ण्वुल्, त changed to ट; otherwise with टल to be confused, the same aff., and ल changed to ष; a cherisher and punisher, a distributor of rewards and punishments; again, भट्ट said here to mean, authority, ऋ to go to or obtain, अण् aff., कन् added.

n. (-रं)
Sunday.
E.
भट्टारक, and वार a day.

f. (-नी)
1 A queen, who has been consecrated as well as her husband; (a theatrical term.)
2 The wife of a Brahman.
E.
भट्ट authority: see etymology of the last word, इनि and ङीप् affs.

m. (-कः)
Price, especially paid for the use of any thing or person; wages, hire.
E.
भट to hire or maintain, aff. ण्वुल्.

f. (-ठिः)
Wages, hire, fee.
E.
भट to hire, इञ् aff.
